tasks.name: Acrithis Shop
tasks.label: Acrithis Shop
info: Visit [Acrithis](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Acrithis) in duviri or the zariman and see what she has to offer.

tasks.name: Teshin - SP Honours
tasks.label: Teshin - SP Honours
info: Visit [Teshin](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Teshin) in a relay for his [weekly offerings](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/The_Steel_Path#Steel_Essence).

tasks.name: Iron Wake - Rivens - Other
tasks.label: Iron Wake - Rivens
info: Visit [Palladino](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Palladino) at Iron Wake on earth, for the weekly rivens, and other weekly items.

tasks.name: Bird 3 - Shard
tasks.label: Bird 3 - Shard
info: Visit [Bird 3](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Bird_3) in the [Sanctum Anatomica](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Sanctum_Anatomica) for the weekly archon shard.

tasks.name: Yonta - Kuva
tasks.label: Yonta - Kuva
info: Visit [Yonta](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Archimedean_Yonta) in the [Zariman](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Zariman_Ten_Zero) for the weekly Kuva.

tasks.name: Ayatan Hunt
tasks.label: Ayatan Hunt
info: Visit [Maroo](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Maroo) on Mars and complete her Ayatan Hunt.

tasks.name: Help Clem
tasks.label: Help Clem
info: Visit [Darvo](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Darvo) in a relay, and help [Clem](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Clem) out.

tasks.name: EDA
tasks.label: EDA
info: Finish Elite [Deep Archimedia](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Deep_Archimedea#Elite_Archimedea), visit necraloid in the [Sanctum Anatomica](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Sanctum_Anatomica). Rank 5 Required.

tasks.name: ETA
tasks.label: ETA
info: Finish Elite [Temporal Archimeadia](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Temporal_Archimedea), visit [Kaya](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Kaya) in the Höllvania mall. Rank 5 Required.

tasks.name: Decendia
tasks.label: SP
info: Clear all 21 floors of Steel Path [Decendia](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/The_Descendia).
